entries.762f2993e75b0967: The company manufactures and sells concrete products for waterways, roads, agriculture and forestry, and sewerage, such as box culverts, Hume pipes, heavy-duty pipes and L-shaped retaining walls, for public works. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥11,778 million, making it the largest business, accounting for more than 7 tenths of the total. The consolidated subsidiary Hazuki Kogyo Co., Ltd. carries out slope protection work. The Takamatsu Plant, Tokushima Plant, Yanahara Plant, Hyogo Plant and Ibaraki Plant are the production facilities for this business.
